title: Germany: connection costs, AgNes and capacity-policy boundaries
德国：并网成本、AgNes 与容量政策边界

lifecycle.locator: Date of issue and opening paragraph
lifecycle.stateAnchor: has today started a consultation on the final draft determination

answer: Separate the connection contract, the consulted charging framework and the capacity-law route. None of these records alone establishes a battery fee or income. Fair evidence: the draft and clarification are available; a final decision and source-specific eligibility would change the analysis.
应分别核对并网合同、正在征询意见的收费框架，以及容量法律路径。任何一份材料都不能单独证明电池的费用或收入。证据为 Fair：已有草案与澄清；正式决定及具体适用条件会改变分析。
changesIf: A final AgNes decision, its implementing determinations, authoritative eligibility evidence or the applicable connection contract changes the supported position.
AgNes 正式决定、实施决定、权威资格证据或适用并网合同出现变化时，应重新核对。

title: Start with the mechanism
先辨明机制
text: A connection contribution, an ongoing network charge and a capacity-support instrument answer different questions. The regulator’s BKZ FAQ reports a court decision in the case considered and distinguishes contractual restrictions. It does not supply a universal battery charge. The practical research task is to identify which cost or eligibility condition applies before comparing economics.
一次性并网贡献、持续网络收费和容量支持工具回答的是不同问题。监管机构的 BKZ 问答报道了特定案件中的法院决定，并区分合同约束，但未给出统一的电池收费。研究应先确认适用成本和资格条件，再比较经济性。

title: A consulted framework, not a tariff invoice
征询意见的框架，不是收费账单
text: The official overview traces the 2021 regulatory-independence judgment and the AgNes procedure opened in May 2025. The 2026 announcement then opens consultation on a final draft. A comment deadline closes consultation; it does not itself adopt the instrument or establish an immediately payable tariff.
官方概览追溯2021年监管独立性判决及2025年5月启动的AgNes程序。2026年公告随后就最终草案展开咨询。意见截止日终结咨询，但本身不代表通过文件，也不确立即时应缴电价。

title: Transition certainty and cost allocation
过渡确定性与成本分摊
text: The regulator reports objections about satisfying the proposed FID condition. Its clarification rejects reading the explanatory percentage as a universal minimum threshold. The competing concern is understandable: transition protection must distinguish sufficiently committed investments while the framework reallocates network costs. This is a research interpretation of the documented issue, not an assertion that a particular project qualifies.
监管机构记录了针对拟议 FID 条件可达性的异议，并澄清解释中的比例不能被读成统一最低门槛。文件反映的权衡是：过渡保护既要识别投入充分的投资，也要处理网络成本再分配。这是对已记录问题的研究解释，并非认定某个项目符合资格。

title: Read the actual tender class
核对真正适用的招标类别
text: The capacity statute distinguishes tender classes and technical conditions. A general headline about batteries is insufficient to decide eligibility under every part of the law. Read the relevant provision, its technology and delivery conditions, and the implementing process together. Neither publication of the statute nor its long-term design establishes a present payment to an unnamed battery.
容量法律区分不同招标类别和技术条件。关于电池的概括标题不足以判断该法各部分的适用资格。应同时阅读有关条款、技术及交付条件和实施流程。法律公布及其长期制度设计，都不能证明某个未指明的电池目前获得付款。

title: Economic exhibit: inputs remain project-specific
经济影响：输入仍取决于具体条件
text: Observed policy facts belong in one lane; forecasts and scenario arithmetic belong in separate lanes. The cited material does not provide a defensible common currency amount for these mechanisms. The exhibit therefore remains not quantifiable. Required inputs include the connection terms, charging basis, applicable dates and verified eligibility; an invented range would conceal those missing inputs.
已观察到的政策事实、外部预测和情景计算应分列。已审阅材料没有为这些机制造成的影响提供可靠的统一金额，因此经济展项保持“暂不可量化”。仍需并网条件、计费基础、适用日期和经验证的资格；虚构区间只会掩盖缺少的输入。

title: What changed and what to verify next
变化及下一步核对
text: The later FID clarification explains how to read the original draft’s transition conditions, including the illustrative percentage. Verify the final operative record, applicable connection terms and relevant statutory tender class before proposing a material investment reassessment.
后续FID澄清解释了原草案过渡条件的读法，包括示例比例。提出重大投资复核前，应核实最终有效文件、适用并网条款及相关法定招标类别。

questions: Which final AgNes and implementing versions are operative?
Which connection conditions and statutory tender class apply?
Can the exact translated or adapted source excerpts be reused under the accepted rights basis?

pilots.officialId: Gate 2 Criteria Methodology, decision of 15 April 2025
title: Great Britain: a connection offer is distinct from capacity income
英国：并网要约与容量收入应分别核对
answer: Gate 2, offer issuance and Capacity Market participation are separate tests. Fair evidence: the approval, revised timetable and formal capacity amendments are available; actual delivery and facility-specific qualification would change the assessment.
Gate 2、要约发出与容量市场参与是不同检验。证据为 Fair：已有批准决定、修订时间表和正式容量市场修订；实际交付及具体设施资格会改变判断。
changesIf: Verified offer completion, a later operative methodology or rule amendment, or facility-specific capacity qualification changes the supported interpretation.
经验证的要约完成情况、后续生效方法或规则修订，以及具体设施的容量资格，会改变现有解释。

title: Three decisions, three evidence chains
三项决定，三条证据链
text: The methodology approval defines the Gate 2 process. It is not a finding that an individual battery passed that process. The timetable governs issuance, while Capacity Market rules govern a separate participation route. An investor needs the evidence chain for each: readiness and strategic alignment, the actual connection offer, and the applicable capacity process.
方法批准确定了 Gate 2 流程，但不代表某个电池已通过该流程。时间表管理要约发出，容量市场规则则对应另一条参与路径。投资研究需要分别取得准备程度和战略匹配证据、实际并网要约，以及适用的容量市场流程证据。

title: Approval and later timetable changes
批准与后续时间表变化
text: The final decision recounts policy development from the May 2023 open letter through 2024 reforms and the 2025 consultation and approval. The June 2026 letter sets phased issuance deadlines; the October letter revises only Phase 1. Approval, issuance, acceptance and energisation require distinct evidence.
最终决定回顾了从2023年5月公开信、2024年改革到2025年咨询与批准的政策演进。2026年6月函件规定分阶段发出期限，10月函件仅修订第1阶段。批准、发出、接受与送电均需各自证据。

title: A deadline is not delivery evidence
期限不是交付证据
text: The October letter preserves other timetable elements and encourages later written confirmation of completion. An elapsed issuance deadline therefore does not prove that every offer was sent or accepted, or that a site was energised. Report the limited revision and identify the missing completion evidence; do not substitute a calendar calculation for an observed outcome.
十月函保留其他时间表要素，并鼓励之后书面确认完成情况。因此，要约发出期限已过去，并不证明全部要约已发出或接受，更不证明场址已经送电。应报告有限修订并明确缺少的完成证据，不能用日历推算代替实际观察。

title: Discretion and transparency
裁量与透明度
text: The primary consultation record contains competing views. One response criticised operator discretion for reducing transparency. Other responses accepted bounded discretion while seeking principles and processes for balancing trade-offs. This supports a sourced stakeholder scene. It does not establish unanimous support or let the research infer how discretion was exercised for an individual connection.
原始咨询记录包含不同意见。一份意见批评运营方裁量降低透明度；其他意见认可有限裁量，同时要求明确平衡各项权衡的原则和程序。这些证据可支撑利益相关方图示，但不能被改写为各方一致支持，也不能据此推断某一并网申请实际如何受到裁量。

title: Follow the whole capacity-rule chain
沿完整容量规则链核对
text: The storage nomination provision must be read with later connection-capacity constraints and reporting amendments. Nomination is distinct from de-rating, award and payment. The economic exhibit remains not quantifiable without the facility’s applicable capacity and agreement data. The consultation record also says the multiple-price proposal would not be implemented ahead of Prequalification 2026; an abandoned proposal is not an operative mechanism.
储能容量申报条款须与后续并网容量限制、报告修订一并阅读。申报不同于容量折减、中标和付款。缺少具体设施的适用容量及协议数据时，经济展项仍不可量化。咨询记录还表明多价格方案不在 2026 年预审前实施；被放弃的建议不能被当作现行机制。

title: What changed and what closes the gap
变化及如何补齐证据
text: The timetable letters and later capacity amendments establish distinct process and eligibility changes. They do not themselves establish a facility’s connection or income. Obtain the actual offer and qualification records before proposing a material change to an approved investment interpretation.
时间表函件与后续容量修订分别确立流程及资格变化，其本身不证明某设施已经并网或取得收入。在提出已批准投资解读的重大调整前，应取得实际要约与资格记录。

questions: Was the exact offer issued and accepted?
Which later methodology and connection-capacity provisions apply?
Which facility-specific de-rating, award and payment conditions are evidenced?

pilots.officialId: National Electricity Amendment (Integrating energy storage systems into the NEM) Rule 2021 No.13
title: NEM: spot participation, FCAS registration and support contracts
NEM：现货参与、FCAS 注册与收入支持合同

lifecycle.locator: PDF p.3, summary and dated footer

answer: Market registration, FCAS capability and underwriting are separate routes. Fair evidence: original rules and current guidance/tender conditions are available; consolidated amendments, facility approvals and executed support terms would change the interpretation.
市场注册、FCAS 能力与收入保障属于不同路径。证据为 Fair：已有原始规则和当前指南、招标条件；后续汇编修订、设施批准及已签支持条款会改变解释。
changesIf: Current consolidated legal changes, actual FCAS accreditation, or an applicable executed CISA/LTESA changes the supported position.
现行汇编法律变化、实际 FCAS 认证，或适用且已签署的 CISA／LTESA，会改变现有判断。

title: Participation is distinct from support
参与资格与收入支持应分开
text: The original IESS rule places the buying and selling of electricity by market bidirectional units within spot settlement. Its IRP category simplifies a participation framework; it does not award an underwriting contract. Read this spot-market foundation alongside the separate FCAS guide and competitive support tenders. A shared battery technology does not make these rights interchangeable.
IESS 原始规则将市场双向机组的购售电置于现货结算框架。IRP 类别简化了参与制度，但不授予收入支持合同。应把这项现货市场基础与独立 FCAS 指南、竞争性收入支持招标分别阅读。同为电池技术，并不意味着这些权利可以互换。

title: Preserve original and later milestones
保留原始与后续里程碑
text: The original rule separates its schedule commencement dates. Those as-issued dates remain historical evidence even where later implementation or amendments differ. The FCAS guide supplies a separate version history leading to the current release. A guidance revision is not repeal of the IESS rule, and an operator timeline should not silently replace an original legal commencement clause.
原始规则区分各附表的生效日期。即使后续实施或修订有所不同，这些发布时日期仍属于历史证据。FCAS 指南另列通向当前版本的修订历史。指南换版不等于废除 IESS 规则，运营方时间表也不能静默替换原始法律生效条款。

title: FCAS remains a capability and registration test
FCAS 仍须能力及注册检验
text: The current guide adds post-fault simulation and clarifies testing requirements. It also records earlier versions. That supports a genuine revision example, while leaving each facility’s technical performance and registration to its own evidence. Name the service and applicable guide version. A battery specification or a guide’s publication cannot demonstrate an actual accreditation or sustained ancillary-service income.
当前指南新增故障后仿真并澄清测试要求，同时记录较早版本。这可支撑真实的修订示例，但各设施的技术表现和注册仍须自身证据。应明确服务种类和适用指南版本；电池规格或指南公布都不能证明实际认证或持续辅助服务收入。

title: CIS and NSW LTESA have different boundaries
CIS 与 NSW LTESA 的边界不同
text: CIS Tender 10 separates an aggregate equivalent-duration target from minimum project criteria. The NSW long-duration tender has different duration and regional conditions and prohibits simultaneous support contracts for the same project. Eligibility, tender assessment and execution are successive questions. Neither a national target nor an open programme description establishes a facility’s contractual right to support.
CIS 第 10 轮区分合计等效时长目标与项目最低条件。NSW 长时储能招标具有不同的时长及区域要求，并禁止同一项目同时持有两种支持合同。资格、招标评审与协议签署是逐步核对的问题，国家目标或计划介绍都不构成设施取得支持的合同权利。

title: Entry barriers and fair cost recovery
进入壁垒与合理成本分摊
text: AEMO’s original request sought storage-specific participation changes. The final determination chose a flexible, technology-neutral IRP design and changed recovery of non-energy costs. The documented design question is how to facilitate two-way resources while allocating service costs. This is distinct from a claim that netting flows eliminates charges or that every participant receives the same saving.
AEMO 原始申请提出了针对储能的参与制度变化。最终决定采用灵活、技术中立的 IRP 设计，并调整非电能成本回收。文件涉及的设计问题是如何促进双向资源参与，同时分摊系统服务成本。这不等于认定净额处理消除了收费，也不意味着每位参与者取得同样节省。

title: Economic exhibit and remaining evidence
经济展项与剩余证据
text: Keep cost allocation, earned service revenue and conditional contractual support in separate lanes. The current evidence does not establish a comparable facility payment, so the monetary impact stays not quantifiable. The next useful evidence is the applicable current rule, measured facility capability and actual support terms. NEM evidence must never be inherited by WA without separate scope support.
成本分摊、已赚取的服务收入和附条件合同支持应分列。现有证据不足以确定可比设施付款，因此金额影响保持不可量化。下一步需要适用的现行规则、实测设施能力和实际支持条款。没有独立范围证据，NEM 材料不得沿用至 WA。

Which FCAS service has the facility actually registered?
Which support contract, scope, eligibility and non-stacking conditions apply?

pilots.officialId: Wholesale Electricity Market Amendment (RCM Reviews Sequencing) Rules 2025
title: WA: capacity credits, price mechanics and ESS accreditation
WA：容量额度、价格机制与 ESS 认证

lifecycle.stateAnchor: Market Rules made by the Minister for Energy.

answer: Separate capacity eligibility, the price calculation and each ESS accreditation. Fair evidence: staged commencement notices and the existing consolidated rules are available; later notices, facility credits and authorized current-source access would change the assessment.
应分别核对容量资格、价格计算和各项 ESS 认证。证据为 Fair：已取得分阶段生效公告及汇编规则；后续公告、设施容量额度和获准的现行来源访问会改变判断。
changesIf: A later commencement notice, verified current rule amendment, facility credit/accreditation decision or accepted source-use authorization changes the supported position.
后续生效公告、经验证的现行规则修订、设施容量额度或认证决定，以及来源使用授权，会改变现有判断。

title: Do not combine distinct entitlements
不同权利不能合并推断
text: The Reserve Capacity Mechanism, its price calculation and Essential System Services use different conditions. A capacity-credit outcome is not a general ESS accreditation, and an ESS capability is not a capacity-price guarantee. Treat WA as its own market. A national battery headline or an NEM participation rule cannot establish these WEM rights.
储备容量机制、价格计算与系统必要服务各有不同条件。容量额度结果不是一般性 ESS 认证，ESS 能力也不保证容量价格。WA 必须作为独立市场处理，全国性电池标题或 NEM 参与规则都不能证明这些 WEM 权利。

title: Gazettal is one date among several
公报公布只是多个日期之一
text: The official history traces reviews from 2022, rules made in December 2023 and later resequencing. The 2025 Gazette distinguishes several schedule dates; the 2026 notice supplies a later commencement and relative order. Publication, signature and commencement remain separate facts.
官方沿革追溯2022年起的审查、2023年12月制定的规则及后续实施顺序调整。2025年公报区分多个附表日期，2026年通知补充后续生效日期及相对顺序。公布、签署与生效仍是不同事实。

title: A known predecessor still has an order
已知前序日期仍须保留顺序
text: The predecessor time for the later sequence is known; the notice nevertheless says the relevant change follows immediately after it. The earlier review’s unspecified-date gap is therefore corrected without replacing relative order by an invented simultaneous instant. A remaining schedule still requires its own notice. Missing current evidence must remain visible rather than be filled from neighbouring schedules.
后续顺序中的前序规则时间已知，但公告仍规定有关变化须紧随其后。由此可修正较早审阅中的日期不明问题，同时不把相对顺序替换为虚构的同时生效。另一个附表仍需要自身公告，缺少的现行证据应明确保留，不能从相邻附表推填。

title: Investment certainty and network priority
投资确定性与网络优先级
text: The consultation records a disagreement over priority for new NCESS facilities compared with existing facilities. The authority defends top priority where NCESS avoids inefficient reinforcement. It also explains why mutually exclusive facility variants cannot all proceed through later capacity processes. This is a documented trade-off, not consensus that every battery should have first-priority network access.
咨询记录了新 NCESS 设施相对现有设施的优先级争议。主管部门以 NCESS 能避免低效增容说明最高优先级，并解释为何互斥设施方案不能同时进入后续容量流程。这是已记录的权衡，不是所有电池都应取得最高网络接入优先级的共识。

title: Read the formula and the separate service approval
核对公式和独立服务批准
text: The flexible daily price is a non-negative difference, not the sum of two full headline capacity prices. Actual payments depend on applicable credits and rules. Separately, the ESM accreditation provisions require a facility application, information, tests and an approval or rejection. These mechanisms can be compared as sourced conditions; they cannot be added into an unsupported common income number.
灵活日容量价格是非负差额，并非两项完整容量标价之和。实际付款取决于适用容量额度和规则。另一方面，ESM 认证条款要求设施申请、信息、测试，以及批准或拒绝。这些机制可以作为有来源的条件进行比较，但不能合成为缺乏依据的统一收入数字。

title: Economic exhibit and source boundary
经济展项与来源边界
text: The monetary exhibit remains not quantifiable until the capacity year, facility credits, prices and service outcomes are supported. Establish the current rule version and any further commencement notice before declaring complete current coverage or proposing a materially different investment conclusion.
在容量年度、设施容量额度、价格及服务结果得到证据支持前，货币影响仍不可量化。应核实当前规则版本及任何后续生效通知，再宣布现行覆盖完整或提出重大不同的投资结论。
